query: SELECT c.id, c.status, c.updated_at, a.id as assessment_id, a.created_at as assessment_started, a.updated_at as assessment_updated FROM claims c LEFT JOIN ai_assessments a ON a.claim_id = c.id WHERE c.claim_number LIKE '%B915065B%' LIMIT 1;
